function.arguments: {"finding": "The treatment and control arms are highly imbalanced in severity: the treatment arm has a much higher proportion of severe cases (41.3%) compared to the control (4.9%), while the control has more mild cases (71.6%) vs treatment (20.3%). The observed lower response rate in the treatment arm may be due to the higher severity, not the treatment itself.", "implication": "The raw difference in response rates cannot be interpreted as a causal treatment effect.
